description: Single-agent skill lab - EVOLVE set. Flawed prompt bakes PTO/sick/remote + vague 'competitive benefits' and says 'answer only from the above, else contact HR'. All questions ARE answerable via lookup_company_policy / lookup_benefits (run with POLICY_AGENT_INCLUDE_BENEFITS=1). The flaw makes the agent defer/give vague answers, especially on benefits. Algorithm should learn a tool-first rule.
